title: Why did Ame and his siblings not stay under the same roof as Dea?
content:
The main reason Ame refused when Dea offered to take them in was because he knew the emotional pain and burden that would leave Dea later on.

Ame noticed since a long time ago that he looks quite similar to his mother, Aspella, and he also knows that Dea blames herself for her death.

With that knowledge in mind, he knows that if he and Dea were to live under the same roof, the emotional pain Dea would have to carry would be unbearable — hence why he refused strongly to the idea of him, Ashi, and Aspen living with her.

They ended up agreeing on Dea and Xion sending food and money occasionally to them.

title: Asal Usul Nama (Origin of the Name)
content: Asal Usul Nama (Origin of the Name) — a chat snippet where Sunshine jokes about baby names before landing on 'Starlight', inspired by a conversation about naming him after the sun and moon.
